text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening claim and repeated stance","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"It states a definite position early and keeps that position consistent throughout the essay."},{"evidence":"\"there could be two to blame here -- the driver or the manufacturer\"","quality":"reasoning depth","description":"It develops its claims with more explicit cause-and-effect reasoning about why driverless cars could create problems."},{"evidence":"paragraph on people assuming \"driveless means\" no driving","quality":"counterargument awareness","description":"It anticipates how users might misunderstand the technology and uses that to strengthen the opposition."},{"evidence":"discussion of liability, attention, driving skill, and cost","quality":"argument development","description":"It addresses several distinct objections in a more focused way rather than listing concerns briefly."},{"evidence":"\"Let's be honest\" and \"Rhetorical speaking\"","quality":"persuasive voice","description":"It sounds more forceful and argumentative, giving the essay more confidence and urgency."}]}
